text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! We're finally at the 
racetrack~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Turf! The air tastes so good! I'm so hyped 
right now!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just loading into the gate is hard 
enough~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
choice_data_list: Let's catch the best wave when it counts!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm in!! How do we do it again!?
choice_data_list: For now, I have to hold back on the fun...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
choice_data_list:
I'll save it all and unleash it in the 
real race!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I'll save my hype for later! Time 
to get changed then~☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You came to cheer for me?! Whew, that's my 
bestie for life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, being "besties forever"... It's 
still a little embarrassing to say out 
loud, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No need to be shy, no need to be shy~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna rock the house! Have a blast☆"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Helios, you're not nervous at all, 
are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's my debut race... Isn't it 
normal to be nervous?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Forget an iron-clad mindset— I've got a 
hyped-up mindset☆"
